title: Save Me, O God

questions.question: Save me, O God! For the waters have come up to my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:1 (ESV): "Save me, O God! For the waters have come up to my neck."

questions.question: I sink in deep mire, where there is no what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:2 (ESV): "I sink in deep mire, where there is no foothold;"

questions.question: I am weary with my crying out; my throat is what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:3 (ESV): "I am weary with my crying out; my throat is parched."

questions.question: More in number than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:4 (ESV): "More in number than the hairs of my head are those who hate me without cause;"

questions.question: For it is for your sake that I have borne reproach, that shame has covered my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:7 (ESV): "...that shame has covered my face."

questions.question: I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother's what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:8 (ESV): "I have become a stranger to my brothers, an alien to my mother's sons."

questions.question: For zeal for your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on whom?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:9 (ESV): "...and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me."

questions.question: When I wept and humbled my soul with fasting, it became my what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:10 (ESV): "When I wept and humbled my soul with fasting, it became my reproach."

questions.question: But as for me, my prayer is to you, O Lord. At an acceptable time, O God, in the abundance of your steadfast love do what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:13 (ESV): "...answer me in your saving faithfulness."

questions.question: They gave me poison for food, and for my thirst they gave me sour wine to what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:21 (ESV): "...and for my thirst they gave me sour wine to drink."

questions.question: Let their table become a snare before them, and their peace a what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:22 (ESV): "Let their table become a snare before them, and their peace a trap."

questions.question: Let their eyes be darkened, so that they cannot see, and make their loins tremble how?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:23 (ESV): "...and make their loins tremble continuously."

questions.question: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living; let them not be enrolled among the what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:28 (ESV): "...let them not be enrolled among the righteous."

questions.question: I will praise the name of God with a song; I will magnify him with what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:30 (ESV): "...I will magnify him with thanksgiving."

questions.question: This will please the Lord more than an ox or a bull with horns and what?
questions.explanation: Psalm 69:31 (ESV): "...more than an ox or a bull with horns and hoofs."

key_verse_text: For zeal for your house has consumed me, and the reproaches of those who reproach you have fallen on me.
